entries.037e07caa55d5da5: It is a second-tier regional bank based in Miyazaki Prefecture. Ordinary income from external customers by service for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,432 million from lending operations, ¥4,083 million from securities investment operations, ¥2,273 million from leasing operations and ¥2,256 million from other operations, with lending operations at the core. Information by region is omitted because the only figure available is ordinary income from external customers in Japan.
entries.158ec78dcab7a5b3: The Miyazaki Taiyo Bank, Ltd. is a second-tier regional bank headquartered at 2-chome, 1-31 Hiroshima, Miyazaki City. The consolidated number of employees is 570 (as of March 31, 2026). It was established in 1941 through the merger of four mujin companies in Miyazaki Prefecture.

entries.2a5cdbfc760545f1: In fiscal 2026, the final year of the medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, the company also intends to implement measures under its basic strategies (the “Business Support Strategy for Corporate Customers,” “Life Support Strategy for Individual Customers,” “Human Resources Strategy,” “Business Reform Strategy through DX” and “Sustainability Management Strategy”) and states that it will work on raising the added value of local companies and solving regional issues. Its basic management policy cites as its motto: “There is no prosperity for the region without the development of the bank, and no service to the region without the bank’s development.”
